title: Phone call pill and queued notification stack
summary: A phone swings in, the camera snaps to its top where a dark call pill materialises, then tilts down as light cards rise from a visible depth queue and a dark missed-call card fades in. Dark-on-pastel contrast sets hierarchy.
use_when: A messaging, calling or CRM app whose value is the stream of incoming events
Showing that a product catches calls and messages the user would otherwise miss
A short silent loop for a landing page hero or a social feed
Phone-first products with no desktop UI to show

look.type_style: system grotesk on UI scale: card titles semibold, bodies regular, about 2 % H at macro framing; lockscreen clock huge thin numerals behind the cards; red accent label on the missed-call card

sfx.event: each notification card arrives in its slot

structure.shot: empty white; a small phone appears edge-on, turns to face camera while growing to about 60 % of frame height, then goes soft
structure.camera: static frame; the device scales about 8 % H -> 60 % H (object move, not camera)
structure.motion: phone y-rotation edge-on -> front with scale up, easings.outExpo 15 fr (f6-f21); at 0.77 the phone is pale and blurred as the push starts (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: macro on the top third of the phone: status bar, camera cutout, a dark call pill with an avatar initial, two-line caller label and red and green round buttons
structure.camera: zoom-tier full -> detail, about 6x in 4 fr (f21-f25), springs.cameraIn; then creep about 1.00 -> 1.03 over 30 fr
structure.motion: call pill materialises in place: opacity 0.15 -> 1, blur 8 px -> 0, no scale, easings.linear 8 fr (f29-f37); content present from the first frame; hold 17 fr

structure.shot: camera travels down the screen: the call pill leaves off the top, four light glass notification cards stream up from below and stack
structure.camera: dolly down about half a phone screen in 9 fr (f54-f63), easings.inOutSine
structure.motion: notification-stack, queue with depth: depth 1 scale 0.89 opacity 0.5, depth 2 scale 0.79 opacity 0.2 blur 1-2 px; each card rises to its slot in 6 fr, springs.ui (no overshoot), stagger 3 fr, first card f55, last settled about f69

structure.shot: two message cards above, a dark missed-call card with avatar, red label line, caller line and a red call-back glyph at the bottom of the screen
structure.camera: drift: slight downward settle, about 1 % over 41 fr
structure.motion: missed-call card materialises at the bottom: opacity 0.2 -> 1 with blur, easings.linear 5 fr (f74-f79); then hold 35 fr

structure.shot: empty white frame, held to the end so the loop restarts on white
structure.motion: phone dissolves to white in 3 fr (f116-f119), then nothing moves for 68 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: bg (white here), accent for the call-back glyph and missed label, wallpaper colours for the phone screen
params.content.caller: caller initial and two-line label (status line + name)
params.content.notifications: 4 cards: app glyph, title, one-line body, time label; two pairs from two apps
params.content.missed: missed-call card: status line and caller name
params.timing.tailHold: white frames after the dissolve (default 68; 0 for a tight loop)

notes: Measured frame by frame at 30 fps (human notes) and checked on 4 fps sheets. The call pill and the missed-call card are not island morphs: they materialise in place (opacity + blur, no scale). Queue depth makes arrivals read as coming forward: depth 1 = 0.89 scale / 0.5 opacity, depth 2 = 0.79 / 0.2. The wide -> macro push is so fast (4 fr) it reads as a match cut. Action ends at 3.85 s; the rest is white. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): device-swing-in, materialize, queue-depth. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
